docs.title: lazy-visual
docs.text:
One-line statistical plots with built-in stats.

import lazy_visual as lv
lv.raincloud(df, x="group", y="score", save="fig.svg")
  • 8 plots: scatterplot, distribution, box, violin, raincloud, heatmap, upset, roc
  • Built-in stats: Mann-Whitney U, Welch, Kruskal-Wallis, Holm, Cohen's d, DeLong/bootstrap AUC CI
  • 4 themes: default, nature, apa, dark
  • Export PNG/SVG/PDF (atomic)

MIT. Deps: numpy, scipy, pandas, matplotlib.

docs.title: Gallery
docs.text:
Same df as Quickstart.

lv.scatterplot(df, x="x", y="y", hue="group", fit="linear", save="scatter.png")
lv.distribution(df, x="score", hue="group", kind="both", save="dist.png")
lv.box(df, y="score", x="group", pairs=[("a","b"),("a","c")], save="box.png")
lv.violin(df, y="score", x="group", save="violin.png")
lv.raincloud(df, y="score", x="group", save="raincloud.png")
lv.heatmap(df, corr="pearson", save="heatmap.png")
lv.upset({"A":{1,2,3,4,5},"B":{3,4,5,6},"C":{4,5,6,7}}, save="upset.png")
lv.roc(df, y_true="class", y_score=["s1","s2"], save="roc.png")

docs.title: Quickstart
docs.text:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, lazy_visual as lv
rng = np.random.default_rng(0); n = 300
df = pd.DataFrame({
    "group": rng.choice(["a","b","c"], n),
    "score": rng.normal(0,1,n) + rng.choice([0,1,2], n),
    "x": rng.normal(0,1,n), "y": rng.normal(0,1,n),
    "class": rng.choice([0,1], n),
    "s1": rng.uniform(0,1,n), "s2": rng.uniform(0,1,n),
})
r = lv.raincloud(df, x="group", y="score", save="fig.svg")
print(r)
lv.set_options(random_state=42)
lv.theme("nature")
